summary: Tested Welcome/Pricing i18n integrity fix for placeholder drift. French and Spanish pricing show meaningful content without placeholder strings. German pricing shows mostly good content but 'Grenze1' placeholder was still visible - added fix to translationLoader.ts to include German 'grenze' pattern. English regression check passed. Mobile responsiveness verified.

issues: 'Grenze1' placeholder visible in Free and Basic plan limitation text - fix applied to translationLoader.ts but requires browser cache clear/rebuild to take effect

action_items: Verify the German 'Grenze' pattern fix in translationLoader.ts is working after full rebuild
Consider adding more German placeholder patterns if other placeholders are discovered (e.g., 'Begrenzung')
critical_code_review_comments: The normalizeWelcomePricingPlaceholderContent() function was missing the German 'Grenze' pattern - added /^grenze\s*\d+$/i to PLACEHOLDER_VALUE_PATTERNS array
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome/Pricing i18n placeholder normalization tested. French locale has proper translations. German locale had 'Grenze1' placeholder issue - fix applied to add German pattern to PLACEHOLDER_VALUE_PATTERNS. The fix adds /^grenze\s*\d+$/i pattern to catch German limit placeholders. Mobile responsiveness verified. English regression passed.
